lore.subject: research/glm-recheck.mjs
lore.fact: research/glm-recheck.mjs re-checks a page's facts with z-ai/glm-5.3-flash: the model proposes URLs, quotes and a rewrite, and a quote counts only if research-audit's quoteFound finds 90% of it on the fetched page; --retry redoes failures, --rejudge re-runs only the checks.

lore.subject: research/glm-recheck.mjs
lore.fact: A figure that a source itself mistypes (Al Jazeera's '$4.3m' for Binance's $4.3 billion) passes glm-recheck's mechanical checks, so a person reads every rewrite and primary sources go in --hints.

lore.subject: public/web.html
lore.fact: The Web (public/web.html) is a fixed radial layout: spokes are the seven investigations, a name's ring is how many investigations name it, its angle the circular mean of their spokes; documented connections are the silk threads.

lore.subject: public/js/blind-pool.js
lore.fact: Blind Pool's pictures are pixel art drawn by public/js/blind-pool.js into low-resolution buffers: #pool (the pool and its caustics), #flowart (a dollar's route by pipe), #leases (the 75-year lease clocks) and #feud (Urbit's pyramid).

lore.subject: research/blind-pool-sources.json
lore.fact: Blind Pool's re-checked facts and their verified quotes are kept in research/blind-pool-sources.json; items the October 2026 re-check could not confirm are marked 'not re-checked' on the page.
